figurative_meaning_en: pleasant conversation; light gossip or chit-chat
example_sentences_in_bangla: সারাটা দিন খোশগল্প করেই কেটে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The whole day passed just in pleasant chit-chat.
The friends got lost in light gossip.
note: Common in everyday Bengali social settings, reflecting relaxed communal interactions.
